comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
You can post links if you remove the "p t t h" (read that backwards without spaces) part of the URL. Like so:

fashionamagiya.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-320.html

From what I can tell, it seems to be related to a series of Maritime Quests where you can fight up to 200/200 NPC ships (!) before reporting a completed quest. Specifically, a 9-star one from out of Istanbul, that sends you up against "first class ship of the line" NPC fleets.

Source: zephyros-eng-royalnavy.jimdo.com/ちょっとためになる情報/海域戦闘/

We don't have anything like that in GAMA yet. Sounds kind of like... something from Gran Atlas Chapter 4: Ancient Glory.

Source: www.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/gran_atlas/chapter4.htm

Since there's no good way to track this weapon down by name, perhaps somebody should add a link to this weapon-slot item's page under the Mineral Trading skill section? It'll be nice to remember this exists when the chance to hunt it down later is finally added in.
